test_sql_to_sql: test the sql.to_sql function to write a pandas DataFrame to a SQL database table
test_sql_read_sql_query: test the sql.read_sql_query function to execute a SQL query and return results as a pandas DataFrame
test_sql_read_sql_table: test the sql.read_sql_table function to read an entire SQL table into a pandas DataFrame
test_sql_read_sql: test the sql.read_sql function to delegate between read_sql_query and read_sql_table based on input
test_sql_get_schema: test the sql.get_schema function to generate CREATE TABLE SQL statements from a pandas DataFrame
test_sql_has_table: test the sql.has_table function to check whether a table exists in the database
test_sql_pandasSQL_builder: test the sql.pandasSQL_builder context manager to execute SQL operations with automatic engine selection
test_sql_get_engine: test the sql.get_engine function to obtain a SQLAlchemyEngine or SQLiteDatabase instance
test_dataframe_to_sql_method: test the DataFrame.to_sql method to write DataFrame data into a SQL database table
test_sql_dtype_backend: test the dtype_backend parameter in read_sql functions to control return dtype selection
test_sql_parse_dates: test the parse_dates parameter in read_sql_query to convert columns to datetime64 types
test_sql_if_exists_modes: test sql.to_sql with if_exists modes fail, replace, and append for table creation and modification
test_sql_chunksize: test read_sql_query and read_sql_table with chunksize parameter to iterate over result sets in batches
test_sql_index_label: test sql.to_sql with index_label parameter to control column names for DataFrame index columns
test_sql_multiindex_roundtrip: test roundtripping a DataFrame with MultiIndex through sql.to_sql and read_sql_query
